description: Plain CSV read fully into memory with data.table fread
notes: Fast to read but holds 155.9 MB per Shiny session; every session pays the full cost and memory scales with concurrent users

description: CSV partitioned by metric scenario granularity
notes: Reduces per page memory but produces 14 files to keep in sync and still loads whole partitions; no predicate pushdown

description: DuckDB single file database queried over DBI
notes: 94 percent smaller than CSV; queries return only matching rows; nothing is held in the R session
Lazy but string predicates such as grepl cannot be pushed down so key filters degrade to a 3 second full scan; also 8x larger than DuckDB because column types were not inferred

description: Compact UI metadata slices for dropdowns
notes: Four small files that populate every dropdown without touching the fact data
